text:
maya: Heads-up — running a small PLG experiment next week: 45-minute Prompt Lab webinar + downloadable Prompt Starter Pack and a 100-credit drip. Goal: increase new signup -> first generate within 48h by ~25%. :rocket:

sam: Sounds good. What's the primary metric? first-run rate within 48h?

maya: Yes. Primary = % new signups that make >=1 generate call in 48h. Secondary = day7 retention and credit redemption rate.

olivia: Routing question — where should incoming webinar signups land? We should auto-enroll into a "credit-lab" cohort and call the promo API to issue credits.

sam: Use growth-webhooks and tag utm_campaign=prompt-lab-credit. I can add cohort routing in the CRM and exclude enterprise domains.

chris: I'll draft three launch posts + a short benchmark narrative for the blog (cost per token baseline + example prompt latency). Variants: technical, product, community. Mock: https://figma.com/s/prompt-lab-assets

aaron: Recommend an A/B arm: 100 vs 200 credits, and another arm that surfaces an inline guided tour in-console showing runnable templates. Aim for ~300 signups/arm.

maya: Keep external copy simple: 'Prompt Lab — get credits, runnable templates, and live help'. We'll push to X, Dev newsletters, and partners.

sam: Tracking: add utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=organic/paid, utm_campaign=prompt-lab-credit, prompt_pack=starter. Events: webinar_signup, credit_issued, first_generate.

olivia: I'll wire automation: signup -> call /v1/internal/promos/issue -> send email with download link + sample prompt CTA. Need promo code text and email template by EOD Thursday.

chris: Draft social copy: 'Try Redwood live — join our Prompt Lab. Get credits + starter prompts you can run now.' I'll post A/B variants tomorrow AM.

maya: Checklist: copy & socials (chris), promo + emails (olivia), webhook & cohort (sam), Figma + benchmark blog (chris), experiment splits & metrics (aaron/sam). Sync 10am PT tomorrow for 20m. :raised_hands:

event-bot: Webinar scheduled: Prompt Lab — Credit + Templates on 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC. Registration: https://redwood.ai/webinar/prompt-lab

maya: Thanks — small and fast. We'll measure first-run and iterate.
